intro: The air ahead is... wrong. A seam of shimmering static hangs where the path should be, and through it the colors are all slightly off.
title: The Tear
description: A rip in reality. Through it you can see this same route — but the creatures moving on the other side are @[TOOLTIP_TITLE]{not quite the ones you know}. The tear hums. It will not stay open long.

1.label: Step Through
1.tooltip: (?) The next stretch of your journey happens on the other side
1.selected: You step through the seam. Reality reasserts itself — but not the one you left. Everything here is Δ.

2.label: Back Away
2.selected: You give the seam a wide berth. Behind you, something on the other side watches you go.

outro: The tear seals itself without a sound.
